title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies — Episode2 Unusual Common Interest

meta.Event Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Line: After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it for what the students who are usually busy with cram school and club activities have been expressing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Alright. I believe our proposal for the next event is ready now. Thank you for all your hard work. Let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you too, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, thank you for yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
And don't be so afraid to ask next time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
By the way, how'd it go?
Did you get that CD you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
Did they run out?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I did buy it, but that was after someone gave me their copy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Gave you their copy?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
There was only one left when I got to the store.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But someone else just happened to get to it just before I did... And then, they gave that copy to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It seemed like she was looking forward to listening to it too. I feel awful about what happened...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The CD itself was amazing...
And I desperately wish that they could listen to it too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That means...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, weren't you saying that you're getting that new CD today? Did the shop run out or something?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, there was one left, but this other person seemed to really want it so...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
Maybe, just maybe, I know the person you're talking about, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, really. I heard something eerily similar from her yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Would you mind telling me more about her?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's about our age and in terms of characteristics... She seems like a delicate flower with very long hair.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, and she usually only ever wears sweats. I have a feeling that she went out to buy that CD of yours in her usual attire.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
I... I think it's her!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling it was her.
Hehe. Stranger than fiction, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, it is a little hard to believe.
Including the part about giving me her copy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: C-Could I ask you to do something else for me...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I... I really want her to listen to this CD... Would you be willing to hand my copy over to her?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Likewise.
She mentioned how she wants to use it as reference material so I'm sure she'll be elated to hear this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Reference? Does she write her own music?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. She's apparently been composing since before junior high school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before junior high...? That's incredible. May I ask what kind of music she writes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Are you interested in writing your own music, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I actually formed a band with my childhood friends and we've been doing some performances.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A band?
I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-yes, we're trying to become professional musicians together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we've been trying to write our own songs as part of achieving that goal, but it's turning out to be more difficult than we initially realized...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
I don't know much about being in a band, but the pros certainly know how to make some incredible songs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd love to hear your band play sometime, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Unfortunately, we're still nowhere near the quality we're going for.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to write music that can touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Touch people's hearts...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but again, we're nowhere near that level yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm hoping that we'll be able to write and play those kinds of songs someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want us to be that kind of band.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. That's a wonderful dream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
By the way...
What kind of music does your friend make, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What kind...? That's a bit hard to explain. If you're interested, how about I give you the link to our videos?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-You will?!
Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll send it to you now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I can't wait to see them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already this late...
Sorry for keeping you back like this, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
N-No, it was my pleasure!
Thank you for telling me all this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I promise to bring the CD by tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be sure to let my friend know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, thank you! Please do!
